editorial:
Imagine you and your best friends get invited to a fancy island for a free vacation. It sounds like a dream until you sit down at a poker table with a creepy dealer who has a very scary rule. If you lose a hand, you have to play Russian roulette. You will feel the tension immediately as these six friends go from laughing and drinking to fighting for their lives. The vibe is a mix of a high-stakes casino movie and a nightmare where no one is safe. You get to see how quickly people turn on each other when their lives are on the line, making it a wild ride from start to finish.

The acting is great because the panic feels real, and the twists keep you guessing until the very end. While some of the gore might be too much for some, the fast pacing makes it hard to look away. If you love movies that keep you on the edge of your seat, you need to see this. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the detail of the island, or rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move.
endingExplained: In the final scene, the last two friends fight over the final pot. You find out the dealer was actually filming the whole thing for a secret betting website. The winner thinks they are safe, but the dealer reveals that the final prize was a trick. The winner is forced into one last round of Russian roulette. They lose, and the movie ends with the dealer cleaning the table for the next group of guests.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves high-stakes games and survival stories.
